text:
zoe: Hey finance — noticed a $49.99 charge on my corporate card from GlobalSIM Co on 2026-03-18 (txn id: GS-55671). I bought a travel SIM last month on my personal card but looks like the subscription auto-renewed on the corp card. I can switch it back to personal payment but wanted to check how to handle reimbursement or reversal.

harry_finance: thanks for flagging, @zoe. quick q: did you intentionally enroll the corp card for that subscription at any point? if not, we can raise a reversal with card provider and ask GlobalSIM for refund. please attach the merchant email/receipt if you have it.

zoe: i have the original purchase receipt showing personal card used (last month) and a renewal email from GlobalSIM that lists the corp card masked number. pasted small snippet: 

```
GlobalSIM: Renewal Notice
Amount: $49.99
Date: 2026-03-18
Payment method: Visa **** 1234
Order ID: GS-55671
```

ron_manager: if the subscription was for an upcoming client trip and Zoe used it for work, i can approve reimbursement if reversal isn't possible. ron_manager approves one-time exception if provider won't refund.

harry_finance: ok. two parallel paths: 1) Finance opens dispute/reversal with card provider citing unauthorized subscription renewal and requests refund to corp card. 2) If provider denies refund, we can reimburse Zoe personally but only with manager exception and proof of business use. @opsbot create a ticket and label either "card-dispute" or "manual-reimbursement" based on outcome.

opsbot: Ticket created: SP-2026-559. Linked docs: Zoe receipt + renewal email. Next step: Finance to submit dispute form within 3 business days.

zoe: thanks. if we reimburse instead, do i file as "Software subscriptions" or "Travel - Telecom"? also curious about tax treatment.

harry_finance: categorize as "Telecom - Travel" in the expense app since it was used for a client trip. For tax: small one-off reimbursements for business tools are non-reportable to payroll if they match a business expense and are documented; if provider treats this as a subscription benefit, we may need payroll to assess. we'll mark as non-taxable in our reimbursement memo but finance will confirm.

ron_manager: i confirm this was business-related for the client trip to London. i will sign the manager exception if refund is not issued.

harry_finance: thanks. Zoe, for now leave the expense pending and add note "Corp card auto-renewal under dispute SP-2026-559; manager pre-approval available." If dispute fails, submit expense as Personal reimbursement with attached proof and manager approval.

zoe: done — added note and uploaded receipts. appreciate the quick help.

harry_finance: will post updates here once card provider responds (5-7 business days). :thumbsup:
